---
title: "Moscow on the Molonglo"
date: "2005-09-21"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

[Max Corden](http://www.theaustralian.news.com.au/common/story_page/0,5744,16668033%255E12332,00.html "Max Corden") calls for the de-Stalinisation of higher education in his Sir Leslie Melville Lecture.  I seem to recall one ANU economist back in the 1980s presciently referring to the Dawkins White Paper as a [GOSPLAN](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gosplan "GOSPLAN") for higher education.
